ideas.name: Instruction-echo inversion as black-box CoT-backdoor defense
ideas.problem: BadChain (ICLR 2024) claims detection impossible because trigger unknown to defender; existing detectors 11-42% (ShadowCoT Table VIII).
ideas.method: Invert the injected instruction from the victim's traces using the C3/C4 echo (n-gram excess over mismatched-instruction null); flag anomalous recovered instructions. TML analogue: Neural Cleanse / trigger inversion lifted to prompts.
ideas.theory: Identifiability from echo excess; conformal p-values on echo score for finite-sample FPR.
ideas.experiments: BadChain/BadThink-style triggers x 3 generators x 3 datasets; baselines CoS, OLF, UniGuardian (in corpus); paraphrasing attacker.

ideas.name: Byzantine-robust aggregation for multi-agent reasoning
ideas.problem: Debate/relay/MoA pipelines broken by one compromised agent (Prompt Infection, AgentPoison NeurIPS 2024). How many adversarial agents can be tolerated and localized?
ideas.method: Structural obligations per agent (M1 redundancy across agents); aggregator keeps only verifiable sub-claims, then robust aggregation (median/trimmed mean). TML analogue: Byzantine-robust FL aggregation.
ideas.theory: Correct answer recovered if adversarial < n/2 among verified claims; localization under honest majority.
ideas.experiments: 3-7 agent instances on GSM8K/MATH; 1-3 adversaries (wrong-answer, prompt-infection, silent-sabotage); baselines majority vote, plain debate, LLM-judge.

ideas.name: Conformal CoT monitoring with obfuscation-shift detection
ideas.problem: CoT monitors have no per-instance guarantee and collapse 96%-><10% under pressure (2510.19851).
ideas.method: Conformal monitor with prediction sets/abstention; shift detector from our permutation-null machinery flags broken exchangeability. TML analogue: conformal + covariate-shift detection.
ideas.theory: Marginal coverage under exchangeability; detectable-shift condition vs pressure level.
ideas.experiments: DeepSeek-R1-Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B; toy side-task envs; pressure ladder P=0..7.

ideas.name: Structural (computation-order) watermark for reasoning traces
ideas.problem: Trajectory watermarks need discrete actions; ICW (ICLR 2026) is lexical and scrub-vulnerable.
ideas.method: Encode bits in computation order (D1 as method); structural decoder (M1 verifier generalized).
ideas.experiments: LEX vs STR vs ICW under paraphrase + monitor-aware scrubbing; utility cost curve.

ideas.name: Verifiable reasoning checkpoints in relay pipelines
ideas.method: Each relay reproduces one designated redundant computation; verifier checks certificate chain.
ideas.theory: Localization to within one hop under honest verifier.
ideas.experiments: Relay chains with one corrupted hop.

recommendation: P1 or P2 as the pivot (change the problem, keep experiments as motivation). Replicate single-shot mechanism results across generators/relay models first (~1 GPU-day).
